thread:
maria: Heads-up — since ~09:03 UTC we're seeing a jump in 502/504s for hosted inference in us-west2 (edge pool az-b). Error rate +18%, clients reporting truncated streams and partial payloads.
ajay: looking at BGP + provider telemetry now. can you paste a couple sample req ids?
maria: ticket has samples: r-7d1e, r-7d1f, r-7d20. curl shows `HTTP/1.1 502` with body `{"error":"upstream_timeout"}`.
sam: observed spike in dup acks and out-of-order packets on egress to transit-C starting 09:02:10 UTC. quick mtr:
```
HOST edge-usw2-azb
1 10.2.1.1 1.0 ms
2 198.51.200.5 4.1 ms 0% loss
3 203.0.120.8 11.9 ms 30% loss  (shift at 09:02)
4 198.51.200.9 15.0 ms 0% loss
```
ajay: provider (AS64521) telemetry shows queue refill + ECN on 198.51.200.0/24 correlated with a config roll at ~09:01:58. opening NOC ticket and requesting rollback details. :phone:
kevin: routing policy normally failsover to transit-D when loss>10%, but this looks asymmetric — one path still healthy so our health checks didn't trigger. I'll force prefer transit-D for the affected prefixes while we investigate.
oncall: route preference override applied at 09:11 UTC for 203.0.120.0/24 -> transit-D. monitoring window started.
jenn: CS reports 4 paying customers saw degraded live sessions. sending interim status and asking for repro timestamps.
maria: repro steps I used:
1) curl -v "https://api.hosted.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"gpt-medium","input":"hi"}'
2) received `HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway` and response body `{"error":"upstream_timeout"}`

sample tcpdump from edge showing duplicates/OoO:
```
09:02:12.987654 IP 10.10.10.6.443 > 10.0.0.23.51515: Flags [P.], seq 1234:2468, ack 200, win 65535, length 1234
09:02:12.987655 IP 10.10.10.6.443 > 10.0.0.23.51515: Flags [P.], seq 1234:2468, ack 200, win 65535, length 1234  (duplicate)
```
sam: evicted/rotated ~8 workers from the affected edge pool with high retransmit counters; error rate dropped ~10% post-rotation.
ajay: provider confirmed a brief software queue refill after a control-plane push. they've rolled back and applied a mitigation; still seeing a small tail of dup packets.
kevin: after forcing transit-D, 502s fell back to baseline within ~45s. traces show traffic routed via transit-D and token retries behaved normally.
jenn: customers updated; they're asking for RCA + ETA for permanent fix.
maria: follow-ups:
- provider RCA + change window
- add packet-dup / dup-ack metrics to route-health policy (not just loss)
- schedule postmortem in incidents channel once provider RCA received
oncall: note: keep preference in place for 2h and only revert after 24h stable. marking incident mitigated for now. :white_check_mark:
ajay: provider ticket #PROV-4510; NOC contact pinned. will paste updates here.
kevin: small mitigation: bump RTO on edge pool temporarily to reduce retransmit storms and CPU pressure.
maria: closing customer escalation pending provider RCA and postmortem. if anyone has other repro captures drop them here.
